title: Recovering Eric Graham's 1987 Amiga Juggler raytracer source code
summary: A technical blog post documenting the process of recovering and reconstructing the lost source code of Eric Graham's famous 1987 Amiga demo 'Juggler', which was one of the most impressive real-time 3D raytracing demonstrations of its era, featuring a bouncing animated figure with reflections.
problem_solved: Recovering and preserving historically significant computing artifacts by reverse-engineering and reconstructing decades-old source code that was previously lost.
why_valuable: Preserves computing history and provides insight into pioneering 3D graphics techniques from the late 1980s, demonstrating the technical innovation of early raytracing on limited hardware.
